proposed_change: Credit explicit assisted offspring to both donor source and recipient, not whole assisted blocks

credit_rule.unassisted_child: All marginal HV gain to executing arm
credit_rule.explicitly_assisted_moead_child: Half marginal HV gain to MOEA/D, half to RegionExplorer
credit_rule.alpha_status: Fixed experimental convention for two direct participants; not estimated causal contribution
credit_rule.warmup: Exclude each initial neutral block from learning as before
credit_rule.next_round: Compute credited gain divided by actual scored FE of each arm, then existing round_shares
credit_rule.conservation: Sum arm credits equals scored marginal global HV; do not double count reward

required_telemetry: child evaluation ID and executing arm
explicit donor ID and source if used
objective vector of every evaluated child in instrumented MOEA/D blocks
marginal HV versus a shadow global archive in actual evaluation order
raw block reward, per-arm credited reward and actual FE separately
observational_limits: Cannot reconstruct this offspring credit from existing block-only rewards
implementation_invariants: Do not update the real global archive mid-block
Do not change RNG, parents, native operators, initialization, bounds or reference
All native evaluations including rejected or duplicate children count once
Observer alpha=0 must reproduce all original live trajectories
Shadow child gains must telescope to recorded global block gain
HV instrumentation consumes CPU time, not extra objective FE; measure overhead

evaluation_plan.development_gate: Shared-credit mean exceeds passive pair, alpha=0 and BLMR; wins versus passive in at least four of six instance means
evaluation_plan.confirmation: Only after passing the frozen development gate use genuinely new cases; no parameter tuning on additional bank

expected_gain: Unknown; no hypothetical HV or guaranteed advantage inferred
